messages:
alex_m: Heads-up — I spun up an evidence catalog + owner map for the AWS/GCP marketplace listings. Goal: single CSV we can hand to partners and security reviewers. Need owners for SOC2, pen-test, questionnaire, HSM attestations, and a presign/TLL plan for S3 artifacts. Please claim rows by EOD.

jamie: Thanks Alex. Can you drop the initial CSV here? I can take SOC2 and pen-test scoping. :thumbsup:

alex_m: Pasted below (initial rows). This is meant to be editable in the shared drive but we should have a canonical export for marketplace and partner ops.

```csv
asset_id,artifact_name,required_by,owner,storage_path,presign_ttl_seconds,redaction_needed,notes
101,SOC2_Report_2025.pdf,aws-marketplace,gcp-marketplace,UNASSIGNED,s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2025/,604800,true,Need signed cover letter + attestation date
102,3p_pen_test_summary_2025.pdf,marketplace,gcp-marketplace,UNASSIGNED,s3://redwood-evidence/pen/2025/,259200,false,redact IPs and partner names
103,marketplace_security_questionnaire_20XX.xlsx,aws-marketplace,UNASSIGNED,s3://redwood-evidence/questionnaires/,86400,false,latest answers + owner contact
104,hsm_integration_diagram.png,aws-marketplace,UNASSIGNED,s3://redwood-evidence/arch/,604800,false,include KMS/HSM vendor and flow
105,scp_audit_logs_export.zip,aws-marketplace,UNASSIGNED,s3://redwood-evidence/logs/,86400,true,rotate keys before upload
```

tanya: I'll pick up the questionnaire row. I'll sanity-check answers vs the product team and update owner contact.

oleg: I can own HSM artifacts and the audit logs. Quick question: do we have a standard redaction checklist for pen test PDFs?

jamie: Oleg — we do. It's in the security drive but I'll copy the checklist here later. Short version: redact external vendor IPs, internal hostnames, and any customer-identifying data. Also remove raw vuln exploit code.

emily_ops: tagging marketplace-bot to create presigned workflow: @marketplace-bot can you create a presign policy for the evidence bucket with TTLs above and output a template for partners?

marketplace-bot: marketplace-bot: Created presign-policy draft: name=marketplace-evidence-presign-v1, max_ttl=604800s. Template link: https://internal.docs/redwood/presign-templates (requires SSO).

alex_m: jamie — can you claim SOC2 and the pen-test summary in the CSV? If you move rows to your name I'll lock the doc for partner handoff. Deadline Thursday COB.

jamie: Claiming 101 and 102 now. Also pinging Legal about whether we need an additional attestation for the marketplace listing (some clouds want vendor-signed attestation). @emily_ops can you loop Legal in the ticket?

emily_ops: On it — opening ticket with Legal and Compliance. Ticket #MKP-4821. Will link here once created.

oleg: For HSM assets: will upload architecture diagrams + KMS attestations to s3://redwood-evidence/hsm/ and set presign TTL to 7 days. Will also version the diagram with date in filename.

alex_m: Important: for GCP listing we need a separate bundle that excludes certain logs per privacy. Tanya — make a copy of the questionnaire answers and mark "GCP-public" vs "internal" fields.

tanya: Will do. Also will add contact: tanya@redwood.com to owner column for row 103.

marketplace-bot: Artifact uploaded: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf by jamie to s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2025/SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (presigned_url=https://presigned.example/soc2/2025/SOC2_Report_2025.pdf?sig=REDACTED, expires=604800)

jamie: Uploaded the pen test summary (redacted) as 3p_pen_test_summary_2025_redacted.pdf. Path in CSV updated and owner=jamie.

alex_m: Great. Two follow-ups: 1) Emily — confirm Legal says we can share presigned URLs with partner listing teams (not public). 2) Ops — run an automated TTL sweep to invalidate presigns older than 30 days mid-month.

emily_ops: Legal confirmed — presigned links are allowed for partner reviewers, but any external sharing must go through NDA gating. I'll add that as a required step in the CSV notes.

oleg: Ops note: we'll implement TTL sweep script in infra repo and will tag the release with the presign-policy. ETA next Tue.

alex_m: Thanks everyone — I'll export the final CSV to the partner handoff folder and ping the partnerships checklist once Legal ticket is attached. :wave:

jamie: Thanks — moving doc to locked after export. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: marketplace-bot will remind this thread in 48h to verify owners and checklist completion.
